title: Tashnalab mazloom sarwar alvida
body:
Tashna Lab Mazloom Sarwar Alwedaa
Fatima Zehra Ke Dilbar Alwedaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaan-E Majlis Tha Tumhaara Zikr-E Gham
Rounaq-E Mehraab-O Mimbar Alwedaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Jawaani Bhi Wabaale Zindagi
Ab Tumhaare Gham Me Akbar Alwedaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Lijiye Aun-O Mohammed Ab Salaam
Saberaa Zainab Ke Dilbar Alwedaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Se Ab Naqsh-E Wafaa Mit-Ta Nahi'n
Jaao Abbas-E Dilaawar Alwedaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Majlisou'n Me Humko Rota Chowd kar
Muskuraate Jaao Asghar Alwedaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Na Zainab Jaaogi Tum Sar Khule
Nazr Hai Ashkou'n Ki Chaadar Alwedaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Rote Hai Baqir Muhibbaan-E Hussain
Kehte Hai Sibte Payamber Alwedaa
